name: relex
description: Relex legal practice management for Gemini CLI: work across your Relex workspace (matters, know-how, research, ontology, agreements, intake, e-signature, invoices and payment status) over a PII-safe MCP connector (thirteen tools: ten matter tools plus search, read_api and execute). Party identities are sealed with a key only the user holds, documents are read and redacted by the Relex Private Model, and the assistant works with de-identified labels.
